jobs.title: Director of Engineering & Development
jobs.description:
Overview

SitelogIQ
is a world-class team making a large-scale impact on the efficiency and sustainability of the places we live, work, shop, and heal.

SitelogIQ delivers turnkey solutions across energy efficiency: lighting upgrades
, EV infrastructure
, solar and energy storage system
[distributed generation (DG)] , and other facility improvement measures (FIMs)
that transform built environments and breathe life into the sustainability, financial, and resiliency goals of real estate teams, corporations and public sector organizations across the U.S. Our mission is to make buildings better while making it easy for our clients to accelerate their impact.

Job Summary

The Director of Engineering & Development for Distributed Generation
within our Commercial Markets Division
provides strategic leadership and oversight of the project engineering and development function and team. This role establishes departmental priorities and standards across team management, tools and systems, project scope development, engineering execution, budget estimating, scheduling, quality, risk management, and workflow.

Key Components Of This Role Include

Management: Strategic leadership and management of the DG team, including Project Development Engineers; oversight of resource planning, project priorities, workflows, day-to-day operations, training and mentoring, performance, and continuous improvement.
Project Engineering & Development: Direct, facilitate, and/or review site survey [audit] analysis, conceptual project designs, estimating, schedules, product specifications, code research and application, and the preparation of proposal documents.

An effective SitelogIQ Director of Engineering & Development will partner with leaders across Sales, Operations, and Project Management and represent the team and its technical solutions to clients and their technical staff. They will oversee program and project development milestones to deliver timely, comprehensive proposals that clearly communicate project intentions and solutions while meeting SitelogIQ financial and risk metrics. SitelogIQ team members are expected to share knowledge with others by serving as a constant contributor, trainer, mentor, and resource.

Target Salary:
$145,000 - $180,000 dependent on experience.

Director, Engineering & Development Responsibilities

Provide leadership, direction, coaching, and mentorship to the team as they develop and produce DG project designs and proposals.
Oversee the internal proposal queue, resource allocation, team assignments, risk review process, and client commitments.
Facilitate collaboration between the Engineering & Development and Sales teams to determine customers’ specific technical requirements, project scope, definition of work, and product feature needs.
Establish and maintain quality standards for project designs, submittals, and permitting packages.
Lead the development of new processes, tools, and workflows and the continuous improvement of existing practices.
Partner with Sales to define customers’ technical requirements, project scope, definition of work, and product or system feature needs.
Participate in site-surveys, pre-bid and pre-construction meetings as needed; noting that SitelogIQ’s commercial markets team does have an Assessment team devoted to supporting all types of site-surveys including DG projects.
Maintain all internal documentation in a collaborative file sharing and storage environment.
Lead technical strategy and support for large RFP and business development opportunities.
Participate in quality control review of peer project development team
Ensure effective coordination of installation details with Project Managers and Account Executives and support field installation when needed.
Oversee the evaluation of site audits and selection of product solutions that provide clients with the optimal balance of functionality, long-term operating expense, aesthetics, and constructability.
Establish quality control standards and review submittal packages (product data sheets; bill of materials; standard and customer drawings; layout and connection detail drawings; return on investment analysis; etc.) for content accuracy and alignment with proposal goals.
Review and markup drawings for typical product applications
Review and present DG solution proposals
Ensure local jurisdiction code compliance research is completed and incorporated into project solutions.
Partner with construction leaders to establish accurate project cost estimates.
Establish design intent and specifications and ensure the team consistently meets them.
Provide technical leadership for large RFP and business development opportunities, including the creation of detailed submittal packages.
Coordinate installation details with Project Managers and Account Executives. Support field installation when needed
Lead quality control reviews of projects
Any, and all ad hoc reporting, requests or other tasks deemed

Director, Engineering & Development Requirements & Qualifications

Industry experience and credentials required:
At least 10 years of progressive experience in engineering, project development, or a related field.
Demonstrated experience leading, managing, and developing a team.

Active Professional Engineer license in at least one U.S. jurisdiction, with the ability to obtain additional licenses through comity as required.
Experience understanding audit and field survey data and translating that into design documents and drawings.
Experience performing sales liaison and client collaboration in energy or related industries.
Strong understanding of DG systems and corresponding customer requirements.
Excellent understanding of financial business principles.
Adept at project scheduling, task definition and effort estimation.
Demonstrated ability to lead projects from concept through completion.
Strong design evaluation, documentation writing skills, problem solving skills, and attention to detail.
Professional communication and presentation skills.
Must be able to work independently, with minimal supervision under time sensitive deadlines.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office products such as Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams, etc.
Experience with file sharing, document management and collaboration tools.

Work Environment And Physical Requirements

This position operates in both office and field settings. While performing the duties of this job, the employee may be regularly required to sit, stand, talk, hear, reach, bend, stoop, kneel, and use hands and fingers to operate a computer, phone, and keyboard. May regularly need to lift up to 20 lbs., unassisted. Travel will be required for site assessments and customer presentations.

Benefits

We offer a highly competitive salary, and comprehensive benefits, including:

Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Disability and life insurance
401K
Flex time off
12 paid holidays
Tuition reimbursement
Opportunities to drive our DE&I efforts by joining our affinity groups, Veterans and Allies Leadership Organization, or Women Inspiring & Strengthening Everyone
Opportunities to give back to our local communities through organized events or fundraisers

More About SitelogIQ

At SitelogIQ, we’re focused on creating a great environment for our team first so that it is more energizing and rewarding to focus on creating great customer experience. That’s what we call a win-win.

We partner with clients in K-12, higher ed, government, healthcare, multifamily housing, and industry to optimize energy efficiency, improve indoor air quality, address lighting, and improve the customer experience. With offices across the country, it’s rewarding to make a difference in the communities where our teammates live and work.

NOTE: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employee may be asked to perform other related duties as required to meet the ongoing needs of the Organization .

SitelogIQ is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in the E-Verify program.

jobs.title: Internal Only: Director of Programs and Engineering
jobs.description:
Director of Programs and Engineering - X-Bow Solid Rocket Motor Division

Company Overview

X-Bow Launch Systems, Inc. (pronounced "Crossbow") is a U.S. defense technology and rocket propulsion company that has developed an innovative, low-cost method to manufacture solid rocket motors. Our propulsion technology, space launch capabilities, and modular boost platforms make us unique and highly desirable aerospace supplier to the defense and national security industries.

Position Summary

X-Bow is seeking an exceptional Director of Programs and Engineering to join our Defense Systems Sector. Reporting directly to the VP of Solid Rocket Motor Programs and Production, this senior leadership position will provide strategic direction and operational oversight for both program management and engineering functions. This role requires a dynamic leader capable of bridging technical excellence with program execution, managing multiple rocket motor development and production programs from initial customer interaction through final delivery while simultaneously leading engineering teams to deliver innovative solutions on accelerated timelines.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

Provide strategic direction and leadership for integrated program management and engineering operations across the Defense Systems Sector

Support the VP of Solid Rocket Motor Programs and Production in developing and executing organizational strategy

Drive alignment between engineering capabilities and program requirements to ensure successful delivery

Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement across programs and engineering teams

Program Management Leadership

Direct and oversee multiple rocket motor development and production programs simultaneously

Develop comprehensive program portfolios that outline goals, timelines, resources, and budget requirements across all programs

Ensure programs are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget while maintaining technical excellence

Serve as senior escalation point for program challenges and strategic customer engagements

Lead proposal development efforts and strategic customer interactions

Engineering Leadership

Provide technical leadership and direction for SRM Engineering and SRM Mechanical Engineering teams

Ensure engineering deliverables meet rigorous design, analysis, testing, and validation requirements for solid rocket motors

Drive technical innovation in solid rocket motor design, development, and manufacturing processes

Balance engineering resources across multiple programs to optimize technical outcomes and schedule performance

Establish and maintain engineering standards, processes, and best practices

Cross-Functional Team Leadership

Lead and coordinate cross-functional teams across Solid Large Motor Programs, Small Motor Programs, SRM Engineering, SRM Mechanical Engineering, Business Management, and Production

Manage and develop program managers and engineering leaders within the organization

Collaborate effectively with Program Scheduling, Production Scheduling, Logistics, EHS, and Quality Management functions

Build and maintain high-performing teams capable of executing on compressed timelines

Stakeholder Communication and Engagement

Serve as a senior point of contact for critical program stakeholders, including executives, government representatives, and external partners

Communicate program and engineering status, challenges, and outcomes to the VP and senior leadership

Maintain transparency and collaboration across all organizational interfaces

Represent X-Bow at customer meetings, technical reviews, and industry forums

Risk Management and Problem Solving

Identify, analyze, and mitigate strategic and technical risks across the program portfolio

Resolve complex technical and programmatic issues, applying advanced problem-solving skills

Proactively address challenges related to requirements, technical development, and manufacturing

Implement risk mitigation strategies that protect program objectives and organizational interests

Quality Assurance and Compliance

Ensure all program and engineering activities comply with organizational standards, industry regulations, and government requirements

Implement quality assurance processes to maintain the highest standards in program deliverables

Oversee rigorous design, analysis, testing, and validation of solid rocket motors

Work closely with Quality Management and EHS teams to ensure compliance and safety across all operations

Resource Management and Business Operations

Manage departmental budgets and resources effectively to meet organizational objectives

Optimize resource allocation across programs and engineering functions

Support business development activities and strategic growth initiatives

Drive operational efficiency and cost-effectiveness while maintaining technical excellence

Continuous Improvement

Evaluate program and engineering performance and identify areas for improvement

Implement best practices and lessons learned into future programs and engineering processes

Champion organizational learning and knowledge management initiatives

Contribute to the advancement of X-Bow's innovative manufacturing methodologies

Required Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Aerospace, Mechanical, or related field) required

Master's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or related field strongly preferred

Experience

Minimum of 10-12 years of progressive experience in the aerospace or defense industry

Minimum of 5-7 years in leadership roles managing programs and/or engineering teams

Extensive experience in program or project management, with demonstrated success managing complex, multi-million dollar programs

Strong technical expertise in solid rocket motor design, development, and manufacturing highly desired

Proven experience in proposal development and management in the aerospace/defense sector

Experience managing cross-functional teams and multiple concurrent programs

Track record of successful customer engagement and relationship management with government and commercial clients

Skills and Competencies

Exceptional leadership and people management skills with ability to inspire and develop high-performing teams

Deep understanding of project management principles, methodologies, and tools (Agile, Waterfall, Earned Value Management)

Strong technical acumen with ability to make sound engineering and programmatic decisions

Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills

Strategic thinking with ability to balance long-term vision with near-term execution

Proven ability to work independently and make decisions with minimal oversight in fast-paced environments

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities

Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results under compressed timelines

Experience with government contracting, ITAR compliance, and defense industry regulations

Location Requirements

This position may be based in the vicinity of existing X-Bow offices, including:

Luling, TX

Salt Lake City, UT

Huntsville, AL

Others

ITAR Requirements

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), you must be a U.S. citizen, a lawful permanent resident of the U.S., a protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

What We Offer

Senior leadership opportunity in a cutting-edge rocket propulsion technology company

Direct impact on national defense and security initiatives

Fast-paced, innovative environment with significant growth potential

Collaborative culture with opportunity to shape organizational direction

Competitive compensation and benefits package

Opportunity to work with world-class engineering and program management teams

jobs.title: Senior Director, Engineering
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Argon Medical is a global manufacturer of specialty medical products, headquartered in Plano, Texas. Argon offers a broad line of medical devices for Interventional Radiology, Vascular Surgery, Interventional Cardiology and Oncology. Argon’s brand is recognized for best-in-class products that improve patient outcomes via percutaneous, image-guided procedures. Our values describe what we believe in and how we operate. These values are our moral compass which guide our decisions and define the deeply held beliefs and principles of our organizational culture. Argon Medical is a family of individuals united by a mission and culture which continue to grow stronger every day.

Position Overview

The Senior Director of Engineering is a critical leader within Argon Medical, responsible for defining and executing the global engineering strategy across our medical device manufacturing operations. This role will lead cross-functional engineering teams, drive technological innovation, enhance manufacturing capabilities, and elevate operational performance across all sites. The Senior Director will partner closely with executive leadership to align engineering initiatives with corporate goals, ensuring scalability, compliance, and competitive advantage.

What You Will Do

Provide strategic vision and executive leadership for global engineering and advanced manufacturing functions.
Architect and implement long-term engineering roadmaps aligned with business growth and innovation strategies.
Lead large-scale process optimization, automation, and cost-reduction initiatives across multiple manufacturing sites.
Champion the adoption of advanced technologies, smart manufacturing, and digital transformation.
Develop and standardize world-class manufacturing processes that drive quality, consistency, and efficiency.
Build and lead high-performing, multidisciplinary engineering teams focused on continuous improvement and innovation.
Collaborate with R&D, Quality, Regulatory, and Operations to ensure engineering excellence from concept to commercialization.
Establish and report on key engineering performance metrics tied to product quality, time-to-market, and operational efficiency.
Ensure engineering programs comply with FDA, ISO, and other global regulatory standards.
Influence capital investments and infrastructure decisions to support long-term manufacturing strategy.
Serve as a technical advisor to senior executives and contribute to strategic planning and organizational development.

Supervisory Responsibilities

Leads a multi-site team of engineers and technical professionals.
Responsible for departmental structure, hiring, performance management, succession planning, and leadership development.
Oversees the execution and prioritization of complex engineering projects and continuous improvement programs.
Provides coaching, mentorship, and professional development opportunities to emerging leaders within the engineering function.

Skills For Success

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a closely related technical field.
Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in advanced manufacturing or engineering leadership roles.
8+ years of experience in senior-level engineering management with multi-site or global oversight.
Medical device industry experience strongly preferred.

Preferred Education And Experience

Master’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration (MBA), or related field.
Certified Six Sigma Black Belt or equivalent lean manufacturing certifications.
Experience integrating new technologies (e.g., automation, robotics, digital manufacturing).

Travel Required

>40% travel required

jobs.title: Director Platform Engineering - SRE / Observability
jobs.description:
Director, Platform Engineering

SALARY: $175k - $240k plus 30% bonus

LOCATION: CHICAGO, IL
HYBRID 3 DAYS ONSITE

You will manage a team of SREs and managers. 7-10 people and managers. Keys SRE observability infrastructure kubernetes kafka aws terraform. j

The Director will lead and manage this team to drive reliability, observability, and cloud platform engineering excellence across a large, complex cloud-based computing environment. The ideal candidate is a hands-on, data-driven technical leader, who can personally raise the bar on SRE and observability practices, reduce waste, optimize cloud efficiency, and improve performance, in close partnership with a dedicated SRE/monitoring team and a centralized architecture function.

Qualifications:

[Required] 5+ years of demonstrated experience leading engineering teams, with an emphasis on developing key talent and cultivating positive, high-performing cultures
[Required] 10+ years of progressive, hands-on experience in software engineering with an understanding of large-scale computing solutions (primarily AWS), including software design and development, database architectures, IP networking, security, cloud operations, and performance tuning
[Required] Demonstrated, hands-on expertise building and maturing SRE and observability practices at scale, able to personally raise the technical bar for a dedicated SRE/monitoring team, not just consume their output
[Required] Demonstrated track record owning the definition and governance of SLOs and SLAs for mission-critical systems, and personally driving resilience engineering practices (chaos engineering, load/performance testing) to validate reliability ahead of incidents
[Required] Demonstrated track record driving reliability through a data-driven culture, waste/toil reduction, cloud efficiency measures, and performance optimization, treating metrics as the primary lens for every decision
[Required] Experience defining, instrumenting, and acting on software delivery performance metrics (DORA metrics, cycle time, deployment frequency, lead time, etc.) to drive engineering improvement initiatives
[Required] Strong consultative, communication, team player, and analytical skills, with the ability to regularly interact between various teams distributed across the US
[Required] Strong technical team leadership and technical project management skills
[Required] Relevant experience leading highly technical team members through adopting new technologies while maintaining highly available, mission-critical systems, with a proven track record of success
[Required] Ability to clearly communicate verbally and in writing to business and technology leaders, architects, developers, and team members
[Required] Must be able to collaborate effectively with a group of high-performing, technical individuals
[Required] Experience acting as a product owner, defining roadmap, requirements, and priorities, for a platform capability such as observability, ideally in partnership with a separate team that owns the underlying tooling and operations
[Required] Experience with architecting, implementing, and maintaining highly available mission-critical environments for 24x7 availability
[Required] Demonstrated history of working within deadlines and ability to work well under pressure
[Required] Experience managing work tasks using Agile methodology/scrum desired

Technical Skills:

[Required] Deep expertise in OpenTelemetry, including instrumentation standards, auto-instrumentation, semantic conventions, and the OTel Collector, as the foundation for a vendor-neutral, paved-road instrumentation strategy
[Required] Hands-on experience with metrics engines and time-series databases, including Prometheus and PromQL, plus scale-out options such as Mimir, Thanos, VictoriaMetrics, or Amazon Managed Prometheus, including cardinality management
[Required] Hands-on experience with tracing and logging backends such as Tempo/Jaeger, Loki/Elastic/Splunk (Splunk is common in financial services), and AWS X-Ray
[Required] Experience with Kubernetes and Kafka observability specifically, including EKS metrics, kube-state-metrics, consumer lag, and broker health
[Required] Experience with alerting and incident tooling such as PagerDuty or Opsgenie, including ServiceNow integration, alert routing, and noise reduction
[Required] Hands-on experience with SLO-as-code frameworks such as OpenSLO, Sloth, or Nobl9, defining and governing SLOs in the repo rather than only in a vendor UI
[Required] Experience delivering golden paths and templates (Terraform modules, Helm charts, pipeline templates) that ship with logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards, alerts, and SLO defaults out of the box
[Required] Experience with resilience validation practices, including chaos engineering (e.g., AWS FIS, Gremlin) and load/performance testing
[Required] Deep, hands-on mastery of observability tooling and practices (metrics, distributed tracing, centralized logging, dashboards, alerting), e.g., Datadog, Prometheus/Grafana, CloudWatch, or equivalent, sufficient to elevate, not just consume, a dedicated SRE team’s capability
[Required] Deep understanding of SRE principles including SLOs/SLIs, error budgets, incident management, and postmortem culture, with a track record of driving adoption and maturity
[Required] Fluency in the Golden Signals, RED, and USE methods as applied frameworks for monitoring and alerting design
[Required] Hands-on experience with: Terraform, Kubernetes, Jenkins or other CI/CD tooling, Kafka, Github, and configuration management tools such as Puppet, Chef, or Ansible

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Digital Experience
jobs.description:
Job Description

About the Role

Our Digital Experience engineering organization is growing from 16 to more than 21 engineers across multiple squads — including three squads working in a shared codebase — while delivering the most consequential initiatives on our roadmap. We're looking for a Director of Engineering to lead this organization through its next stage of growth: its strategy, its processes, its people, and its partnership with Product.
You'll lead through a layer of squad leads who own the day-to-day and performance of their squads (engineers and QA). Your job is to manage, coach, and develop those leads, inspect team-level outcomes, and own the health of the engineering organization as a whole.
The measure of this role is not individual output. It is whether the teams around you deliver faster, more predictably, and with fewer things in their way.
What You'll Own

Engineering Strategy
Be the engineering voice in strategic conversations about what we build and how we build it — participating from the first conversation on new initiatives, not after decisions are made.
Shape how the engineering organization is structured — squad composition, roles, and skill mix — to meet current-year objectives while planning for a multi-year horizon.
Own the point of view on our tech stack and architecture direction: whether what we have today supports where the product is going, and what needs to change before it becomes a constraint.
Partner with Product leadership as a peer when planning future years — Product brings the business perspective, you bring the engineering perspective, and together you organize the squads and the plans.

Engineering Leadership — Process and Tone
Set the process and tone for how engineering runs — the "how" (development and release processes) and the "what" (team functions and responsibilities) — without removing squad independence.
Establish and steward a release process appropriate for an organization of this size: who does what and why, checklists, rollback plans, and cross-team notification.
Define the development process end to end: how PRs move through the system, what the delivery pipeline looks like, how AI is incorporated into engineering work, and what happens when problems arise.
Be the leader engineers look to for expectations. When something isn't clear, work with the leads to make it clear.
Provide stewardship for the squads sharing a codebase as the organization grows — alignment on standards, coordination, and shared ownership.
Bring a clear point of view to Product leadership on what Product should bring to the table for engineering teams to work effectively — and expect the same in return.

Leadership Development & Organizational Health
Manage, coach, and develop the squad leads — your direct reports and the primary lever for everything else.
Build a consistent management practice across squads: how leads run their teams, coach their people, handle performance, and grow their engineers — so an engineer's experience doesn't depend on which squad they're on.
Maintain an accurate talent picture across the organization through the leads: who is growing, who needs support, who is ready for more complex work, and whether people are progressing at the pace we'd expect.
Own engineering throughput at the organizational level: how stories move through development, where they get stuck, and what to change. Find bottlenecks and work with leads to fix them.
Plan capacity and hiring ahead of need as the team scales, so process and staffing don't become the reasons delivery slows down.

Thought Partnership
Come to the table with thinking not just on how tasks get completed, but on how we organize and enable teams to complete them. Removing what's in the teams' way matters more than doing the work yourself.
Be a genuine peer to Product and business leadership — someone who strengthens strategic conversations rather than just executing their outcomes.

What Success Looks Like

First 90 days:
A clear diagnosis of current delivery bottlenecks with a recommended plan, and established expectations with leads on how teams run.
First year:
Release and development processes that scale to 21+ engineers; throughput measurably improved; a lead layer that is managing well and consistently; a talent picture leadership trusts; engineering fully represented in next-year planning.
Ongoing:
Product and engineering leadership operating like sections of the same orchestra — aligned on expectations in both directions, planning the future together.

Responsibilities and Benefits

What We're Looking For

Experience leading engineering organizations of 15–40 people through a growth phase, ideally with multiple squads in a shared codebase.
Experience managing through a leadership layer — developing leads rather than managing every engineer directly.
A track record of building right-sized process — enough structure to scale, not so much that squads lose independence.
Strong people-management instincts: coaching, performance development, and the judgment to make talent recommendations backed by direct inspection.
Fluency with delivery metrics and workflow data; comfort diagnosing bottlenecks and acting on them.
Strategic range: able to contribute to multi-year product and organizational planning, not just current-quarter execution.
A collaborative operating style with Product — a peer partner, not a service provider.

How You're Supported
As part of the Mission Pet Health family, you get the stability of a local practice backed by the comprehensive benefits and resources of a larger network. The focus is on investing in you, so you can focus on what you love.

Note: Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to support you at every stage. Eligibility for specific benefits varies based on your role and hours worked.
Competitive Compensation

A competitive hourly rate or salary based on your experience and role.
Health & Wellbeing

We offer comprehensive coverage options including Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance, along with access to our Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for all teammates.
Financial Security

Plan for your future with our 401k retirement options and additional financial protection benefits like Life Insurance and Disability coverage.
Commitment to Growth

We support your career goals with opportunities for professional development, including educational assistance for qualified teammates to enroll in AVMA-accredited veterinary technician programs.
The Power of a Network

Join a nationwide community of over 20,000 veterinary professionals who share a passion for collaboration, career growth, and sharing best practices.
Valuable Perks

Enjoy discounted veterinary care for your own pets, access to an online discount platform, and free 24/7 access to doctors through Teladoc.

jobs.description:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

Overview

As a Senior Engineering Manager at Fanatics, you will be a technical leader with the ability to grow and scale engineering teams that can deliver business results and ship high-quality software for customer-facing products and internal platforms.

We own the Fanatics App, the mobile app at Fanatics that encompasses elements from all of our different brands and businesses. The Fanatics App brings together Free to Play games, live events, ecommerce, and new product experiences to deliver a best-in-class Sports platform. Fundamentally, we are one team in everything we do, from the user experience to coding and architecture. We aim to deliver on our Customer Promise by delighting our millions of monthly active users.

Responsibilities

Provide leadership and technical expertise within your engineering vertical
Build and lead one or more teams to deliver software while adhering (and contributing) to engineering best practices
Manage, coach, and develop engineers working across mobile and backend platforms
Clarify technical requirements, negotiate priorities, and manage projects to deliver on time by leading daily scrum activities
Work closely with your product and design partners to create an ambitious, yet achievable roadmap that can be communicated to executives and stakeholders.
Drive reliable and predictable team execution by setting clear objectives, using data and KPIs to drive transparency, and champion continuous improvement across engineering practices and systems
Drive effective adoption of AI-assisted engineering workflows, including development tooling, documentation, testing support, code review augmentation, and developer enablement best practices
Provide clear updates (KPIs, status, metrics) to an executive audience and key stakeholders
Help to recruit, assess and onboard a diverse group of talented engineers
Bring together stakeholders across Fanatics to align diverging ideas into an actionable roadmap
Remain technically engaged in architecture discussions, operational reviews, development workflows, and engineering quality practices while empowering engineers to own implementation details
Must be open to occasional travel to Fanatics offices and other locations for conferences, events, meetings, and team-building activities

Required Qualifications

3+ years of experience managing one or more engineering teams

The Senior Manager – Controls and Automation Software Development
is responsible for leading Patterson-UTI’s Controls and Automation Development team, providing the technical leadership, engineering governance, and organizational capability required to deliver safe, reliable, and scalable drilling control systems across the company’s fleet.

This role is accountable for engineering execution, software development processes, architecture governance, software quality, release management, engineering standards, and the continuous development of a high-performing software engineering organization. The Senior Manager leads a multidisciplinary team responsible for PLC software, HMI applications, simulation, quality assurance, and software platform development.

Working closely with Product Management, Sustaining Engineering, and New Projects teams, this leader ensures engineering execution aligns with business priorities while maintaining the highest standards for software quality, technical excellence, and predictable delivery.

This position reports to the Director, Controls & Automation.

Detailed Description

Engineering Leadership

Build and lead a high-performing Controls Software Engineering organization responsible for delivering safe, reliable, and scalable control software across Patterson-UTI’s drilling fleet.
Establish a culture of technical excellence, accountability, ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Lead Technical Leads, Senior Engineers, Quality Engineering, and third-party engineering resources responsible for software development and validation.
Develop organizational capability through structured coaching, mentorship, succession planning, and leadership development.
Define and maintain engineering career ladders and technical competency expectations across all engineering levels.
Develop and maintain the Principal Engineer pipeline by identifying, mentoring, and growing future technical leaders.
Own workforce planning, future staffing strategy, and hiring plans aligned with the Controls & Automation technology roadmap.
Establish and maintain the technical hiring bar for the organization and participate in final technical interviews for senior engineering positions.
Lead the performance management process, ensuring evaluations are based on measurable performance, technical contribution, leadership, and organizational impact.
Promote a diverse and inclusive work environment where employees feel respected, supported, and empowered to contribute their best work.

Technical Governance

Establish the technical direction for the Controls Software Engineering organization while empowering Technical Leads and Principal Engineers to own detailed solution design and implementation.
Govern software architecture through structured architecture reviews, engineering standards, and technical design processes.
Ensure engineering teams consistently deliver high-quality software, documentation, control algorithms, and system designs that meet company standards.
Own the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), including development standards, coding practices, testing methodologies, documentation requirements, release controls, and change management processes.
Define and enforce software contribution standards, including code quality, modularity, documentation, maintainability, and testability.
Own the engineering technical debt strategy by ensuring technical debt is identified, prioritized, and systematically addressed during release planning.
Maintain active technical engagement across all engineering programs by evaluating architecture proposals, identifying technical risks, facilitating architecture reviews, and resolving escalated technical decisions.
Champion modern software engineering practices including AI-assisted software development, automated testing, simulation, continuous integration, static code analysis, and engineering productivity tools.

Own engineering execution for the Controls Software Engineering organization, ensuring commitments are delivered safely, predictably, and with high quality.
Drive the department’s platform release cadence by ensuring development across all engineering teams converges into stable, production-ready software releases.
Own engineering planning, release planning, capacity planning, resource allocation, dependency management, and delivery forecasting.
Conduct regular engineering delivery reviews with Technical Leads to identify execution risks, remove organizational blockers, and maintain predictable delivery.
Make engineering Go/No-Go recommendations for software releases in partnership with Quality Engineering and Product Management.
Establish measurable engineering performance metrics and continuously improve engineering effectiveness.
Drive continuous improvement in software quality, engineering productivity, release predictability, and deployment readiness.
Work closely with Product Management during field qualification, beta testing, and release validation to ensure successful deployment of new functionality.
Establish strong communication channels with field operations and technical support organizations to capture operational feedback and continuously improve engineering deliverables.

Engineering Infrastructure & Platform

Own the long-term evolution of Patterson-UTI’s Controls Software Platform, driving modular architecture, software reuse, hardware abstraction, configuration-driven deployment, maintainability, and scalability.
Maintain governance of the company’s software intellectual property and engineering assets in accordance with corporate policies.
Oversee the Controls Engineering Laboratory, simulation environments, software qualification infrastructure, and engineering validation processes.
Ensure engineering teams have the development environments, simulation capabilities, testing frameworks, and engineering tools necessary to deliver high-quality software efficiently.
Lead continuous improvement of software validation, simulation, and qualification processes to reduce engineering risk and improve release quality.

Courageous Leadership

This individual provides leadership to enterprise architects, senior product managers, technology specialists, and professionals across Technology Infrastructure, Technology Operations Management, and IT Service Management (ITSM). As a member of the Senior Digital Health and Technology Leadership team, the VP/CTO drives technology innovation, transformation, and technical operations; leads Agile/DevOps teams; leads cloud transformation; and partners with clinical, business, and informatics leaders to ensure technology solutions meet end-user needs and support a modern, patient-centered, high-performing health system.

Scope/Span Of Control

Enterprise-wide accountability for technology strategy, architecture, infrastructure, technology operations, service desk/desktop support, and IT service management across all Premier Health facilities and lines of business. Bachelor of Science or Bachelor of Arts

Master’s degree (MBA, MHA, MIS, or related field)

N/A

Healthcare or hospital/ambulatory experience; Digital Leadership or IT Leadership; leading multi-site technology operations, service desk, and desktop support teams across a distributed facility footprint

Other Experience Requirements:
Proven leadership of successful transformation initiatives; deep experience managing enterprise infrastructure and disaster recovery programs, and partnering closely with cybersecurity/security leadership on secure technology operations; experience standing up or maturing an IT Service Management (ITSM) practice and associated tooling; understanding of core business and clinical processes and their associated technology solutions; strong written and verbal communication and executive presentation skills; change management; Lean or Six Sigma experience; vendor contract negotiation; and critical problem-solving and design

Knowledge/Skills

Evaluate emerging technologies and analytics capabilities, proactively identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability, visibility, and the overall customer experience.

jobs.title: Sr. Engineering Manager, Core Services - Slack
jobs.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Software Engineering

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Slack is looking for an Engineering Manager on the Core Services engineering team. The purpose of this role is to keep Slack working seamlessly at massive scale — it's the infrastructure that keeps Slack feeling lightning fast. This person will be a steward of some of the most critical, high-throughput systems at Slack — the kind of work where doing it well means millions of users, at the world’s most important and interesting companies, never experience a hiccup.

About The Opportunity

We operate at tremendous scale with systems that process millions of events per second. Our team maintains and builds performant services that include:

Edge Caches
Realtime Services
Enterprise Key Management (EKM)
International Data Residency (IDR)
Image Uploads, Downloads, and Proxying

We've done our job correctly when none of our users think about us, much like a vital utility. We don't typically ship new user-facing features, but rather ensure our systems are exceptionally performant, highly available, reliable, and scalable. In other words, we make Slack work seamlessly. Slack's backend services are written in Go and Java, and Slack's API is built on PHP/Hack.

The Core Services Team

We are a team building critical services that enable Slack to scale for our largest customers. Our edge caches power the most latency-critical queries for our largest entities today, serving approximately 35% of all Slack API traffic. Our Realtime Services (RTS) power Slack's core messaging stack — running 10 services, 4 of which are mission-critical Tier 0 services — ensuring that messages, presence, and real-time events are delivered reliably at scale. We also own services that power Slack's Enterprise Key Management and International Data Residency features, enabling Slack to win and retain enterprise and government customers with strict compliance requirements (FedRAMP/NIST).

We have a strong commitment to quality and understand that simplicity and reliability are the foundations of our work.

We are actively building the future of edge services at Slack, so we can support a growing number of globally distributed customers with their compliance requirements with minimal latency.

What You'll Be Doing:

Owning the technical direction and roadmap across the Core Services portfolio: Edge Caches, Realtime Services, Enterprise Key Management, International Data Residency, and Image Proxying and Uploads. You’ll have large footprint and the opportunity to drive major impact. And you'll decide what to invest in now, what to sequence later, and what to decline — balancing reliability, migration, and new capability work.
Leading a multi-system migration of Flannel to Loom, our next-generation edge cache, while keeping the current systems running at full reliability for millions of users. You'll drive the team to ship new capabilities without introducing risk to infrastructure that people depend on daily.
Driving delivery and execution while maintaining reliability as a top priority, including sprint planning, product launches, incident follow-ups, operational sustainability analyses, and building the technical case for investment with leadership. You'll ensure the team doesn't trade reliability for velocity, but is always high-performing.
Owning on-call operations and incident management for Tier 0 services. You'll manage on-call rotations across partnering teams, triage production issues, lead incident response for your services, and drive improvements to runbooks, alerting, and operational tooling.
Partnering cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Compliance, Security, AWS, and other infrastructure teams on dependencies, timelines, and risks. You'll be the shortest path to solutions — whether it's unblocking a compliance audit for South Korea, coordinating IDR region launches with Sales and AWS, or negotiating priorities with partner teams for shared work.
Representing your team's work in leadership reviews, quarterly and annual planning, and executive forums. You'll build compelling business-and-technical cases for your team's investments and tell your leadership what's really going on early enough that nothing becomes a fire drill.
Building and maintaining a high-trust team culture where engineers do impactful work and grow. You'll hire well, manage performance with fairness and transparency, mentor emerging technical leaders, and celebrate your team's wins.
Managing cost and capacity for services that run at massive scale, working with finance on AWS spend trends, exec-approved budget increases, and cost-saving initiatives like the Loom migration (projected $1-2M savings).
Driving the team to adopt AI development tooling for maximum impact, while maintaining engineering rigor and quality for critical infrastructure.

You're Our Person If:

You've led engineering teams for 5+ years building and operating high-scale, high-availability backend infrastructure or distributed systems.
You have strong software engineering fundamentals with previous experience as a Senior+ backend engineer, with enough depth to be credible in architecture discussions about caching, distributed systems, observability and reliability best practices, and system design — and to build SME knowledge in a new area fast.
You have a history of managing Tier 0 / Tier 1 services where uptime matters deeply, including owning on-call rotations, leading incident response, and driving operational improvements.
You have experience with realtime messaging systems or event-driven architectures at scale — presence, message delivery, pub/sub, or similar systems where latency and reliability directly impact user experience.
You have experience leading multi-quarter migration or platform evolution projects while simultaneously keeping existing systems reliable.
You've managed teams through prioritization trade-offs — weighing reliability vs. feature work vs. cost vs. compliance — and can articulate those decisions to both engineers and executives.
You have experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders (Product, Sales, Compliance, Security, Infrastructure) to turn business requirements into engineering plans.
You understand how to build a high-performing team culture: hiring, performance management, retention of top performers, and growing new technical leaders.
You have experience managing engineers across multiple time zones, with an async rhythm that doesn't depend on overlap hours.
An understanding of how and where AI software development tooling can be deployed for maximum team impact.

Even Better If:

You have experience with the Go and/or Java programming language at scale.
Experience with AWS infrastructure, including multi-region architectures.
Experience with Kubernetes and container-based deployments.
Experience working within highly regulated environments where an understanding of FedRAMP/NIST frameworks was essential.
Experience with Enterprise Key Management, data residency, or compliance-driven infrastructure.
You've managed teams responsible for Edge Caching, CDN, or API gateway systems.
You've led teams through system deprecation and migration while maintaining service reliability.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form .

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. Salesforce offers a variety of benefits to help you live well including: time off programs, medical, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, 401(k), and an employee stock purchasing program. More details about company benefits can be found at the following link: https://www.salesforcebenefits.com.Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

At Salesforce, we believe in equitable compensation practices that reflect the dynamic nature of labor markets across various regions. The typical base salary range for this position is $172,500 - $260,100 annually. In select cities within the San Francisco and New York City metropolitan area, the base salary range for this role is $207,800 - $285,800 annually. The range represents base salary only, and does not include company bonus, incentive for sales roles, equity or benefits, as applicable.

Repligen is seeking a Senior Service Systems, Infrastructure & Analytics Manager to lead the systems, data infrastructure, integrations, and analytics that support our rapidly growing global service organization. Reporting to the VP, Service, this role sits at the intersection of technology, data, and service operations, partnering across Service, IT, Commercial Operations, Finance, Quality, and Field Service to build scalable solutions that drive business performance, operational excellence, and customer success.

This role is expected to model our Leadership Behaviors—Integrity & Compliance, Customer Focus, Collaboration, Courage, Team Empowerment, and Accountability & Results—in all aspects of work.

Responsibilities

Partner with service leadership to define, document, and continuously improve global service business processes, standards, and best practices.
Translate business needs and user experiences into clear system requirements and scalable technical solutions that support the long-term growth of the service business.
Lead the design, configuration, implementation, maintenance, and optimization of service business systems and infrastructure on a global scale.
Design, manage, and enhance integrations between Salesforce, SAP, internally developed service applications, reporting platforms, and other business systems.
Develop and execute a service master data strategy, ensuring data integrity, governance, consistency, and accessibility across systems.
Build, maintain, and continuously improve dashboards, reports, and KPI frameworks that enable data-driven decision making and provide leaders with clear visibility into business performance.
Develop reporting and visualization solutions using Power BI, Tableau, and related analytics tools to deliver meaningful operational and strategic insights.
Create and manage data flows, queries, automations, and reporting structures that transform data from multiple sources into actionable business intelligence.
Act as a trusted partner to Service, IT, Commercial Operations, Finance, Quality, and Field Service teams, building strong relationships and aligning stakeholders around shared business objectives.
Provide technical guidance and business context to IT and development teams, helping prioritize enhancements, solve complex challenges, and identify opportunities for innovation.
Promote consistency and operational excellence by driving adoption of global processes, systems, and reporting methodologies across the organization.
Develop training materials, user documentation, and support programs that empower users and enable successful adoption of systems and tools.
Evaluate emerging technologies and analytics capabilities, proactively identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability, visibility, and the overall customer experience.
Take ownership of strategic initiatives from concept through implementation, driving measurable outcomes through collaboration, influence, and continuous improvement.
Help shape the future of the Service Systems, Infrastructure & Analytics function by contributing to team development, process maturity, and long-term organizational success.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related field.
7+ years of experience in business systems, analytics, systems architecture, service operations technology, or related disciplines.
Experience supporting field service, technical service, customer support, or equipment-based service organizations.
Strong experience with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, SAP, Power BI, Tableau, and related business systems.
Proven experience designing system integrations, APIs, data flows, reporting frameworks, and business process automation.
Experience developing dashboards, KPIs, and analytics solutions that support operational and strategic decision-making.
Strong understanding of data architecture, master data management, data governance, and data quality best practices.
Working knowledge of SQL, Python, Power Query, DAX, Power Automate, C#, HTML, or similar scripting and automation tools.
Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions and measurable business outcomes.
Proven success leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing stakeholders across Service, IT, Commercial Operations, Finance, and Quality organizations.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with a customer-focused mindset and a commitment to continuous improvement.

What Repligen Offers

Our mission is to inspire advances in bioprocessing as a trusted partner in the production of biologic drugs that improve human health worldwide. Focused on cost and process efficiencies, we deliver innovative technologies and solutions that help set new standards in bioprocessing. The estimated base salary range for this role, based in the United States of America is $134,000-$192,000. Compensation decisions are dependent on several factors including, but not limited to an individual's ,qualifications, location, internal equity, and alignment with market data. Additionally, employees are eligible to participate in one of our variable cash programs (bonus or commission) and eligible roles may receive equity as part of the compensation package. We offer a wide range of benefits such as paid time off, health/dental/vision, retirement benefits and flexible spending accounts. All compensation and benefits information will be confirmed in writing at the time of offer.

jobs.title: Director, Office of Science and Engineering Laboratories (OSEL)
jobs.description:
Duties

Summary

This position is being filled under a stream-lined hiring authority, Title 21 of the United States Code (21 US Code 379d-3a) as amended by the 21st Century Cures Act of 2016, section 3072 and the Consolidated Appropriations Act of 2023, Section 3624. The candidate selected for this position will serve under a career or career-conditional appointment and be paid under the provisions of this authority. This position is being recruited based on the Title 21 Pay Table 4, Band G.

Requirements

Qualifications

In order to qualify for the Director, Office of Science and Engineering Laboratories (OSEL) position which falls under the 1301 occupational Series, you must meet the following requirements by 11:59 pm EST on 10/28/2026: The candidate must meet the following qualifications for this Title 21 position: Scientific, Technical, and/or Professional Fields Qualified and Outstanding Candidates a. Qualified applies to all candidates for Cures appointments. The FDA OTS will use the technical qualifications defined below as a baseline for comparing experience levels and other candidate attributes for relevant positions b, Outstanding candidates can be defined by existing outstanding work experience, outstanding performance rating, or both. Minimum Qualifications: To qualify for a Band G Director, Office of Science and Engineering Laboratories (OSEL) position, you must meet the Education Requirement listed in the Education section below. Desired Qualifications: Possesses a Ph.D. in the life sciences or an M.D./Ph.D. degree, with advanced research and scientific training relevant to the position. The preferred qualification reflects the depth of research expertise needed to lead multidisciplinary regulatory science programs and address complex scientific and emerging technologies. An M.D. without a Ph.D. is not considered equivalent to the preferred research and scientific background. This position is designated as an SES Equivalent position and is covered under the FDA Title 21 Executive Performance Management System and identified as a public filing position for ethics purposes. While PHS Commissioned Corps Officers cannot hold a Title 21 position during their active service as PHS Officers, we welcome and encourage them to apply-their applications will receive full consideration. Please note that if selected, the Officer will need to end their Commissioned Corps appointment before being placed in the Title 21 position. NOTE: Applicants must submit all relevant transcripts that demonstrate you possess the required education to meet the Basic Qualifications. Supervisory Responsibilities The incumbent is delegated full authority to achieve group goals and objectives through the effective management of available resources. Performance and accomplishments are assessed primarily through work performance indicators, staff discussion, planning sessions, review of individual project outputs, and annual program review. Leads in a proactive, customer-responsive manner consistent with Agency vision and values, effectively communicating program issues to external audiences. Ensures financial and managerial accountability by acting with prudence when executing fiduciary responsibilities. Demonstrates high integrity and adheres to the highest ethical standards of public service. Uses effective business practices including balanced measures of results, values, and invests in each employee; emphasizes empowerment and two-way communication. Takes a leadership role in advocating for and advancing the priorities of the Agency. Serves as a role model for leadership by encouraging teamwork and a collaborative approach. Timely notifies Agency officials of all significant actions and developments, including but not limited to those related to regulatory matters, legislative matters, budget matters, reports, initiatives, and events and ensures subordinate managers do the same. Provides reasonable accommodations needed to best utilize qualified people with disabilities. Organizational Management: Manages the Office of Science and Engineering Laboratories (OSEL) within CDRH to sustain and advance a preeminent regulatory science enterprise capable of addressing frontier scientific challenges at the forefront of medical device regulation. Establishes strategic direction and priorities across OSEL's scientific programs spanning life sciences, biological sciences, engineering, physical sciences, and computational sciences. Ensures alignment of OSEL's organizational objectives with CDRH and FDA-wide priorities and regulatory mission. Program Management: Runs a multidisciplinary regulatory science program in the Center encompassing multiple laboratories and scientific disciplines. Directs and evaluates activities addressing scientific and technical questions relevant to medical devices and radiation-emitting products, including test methods, biocompatibility, biological testing, in vitro/in vivo evaluation, computational modeling, and reference materials. Establishes new scientific programs and frameworks in areas without precedent, shaping how emerging and complex technologies are evaluated across the regulatory enterprise. Oversees a highly diverse workforce across scientific, professional, technical, and administrative occupational series. Resource Management: Monitors and reports on resources needed to lead strategic resource planning for OSEL and its multidisciplinary regulatory science programs. Establishes annual and multi-year objectives, determines program priorities, and allocates resources across OSEL's scientific programs. Evaluates the effectiveness and regulatory impact of OSEL programs to inform resource planning and ensure efficient use of available resources in support of CDRH's regulatory mission. Human Capital Management: Identifies employee competencies necessary to meet OSEL's organizational capabilities goals across its multidisciplinary scientific workforce. Designs competency frameworks and workforce architecture to ensure OSEL maintains the scientific capabilities needed for current and emerging regulatory science challenges. Promotes employee development and identifies workforce and succession needs to ensure OSEL maintains the scientific knowledge, methods, tools, and capabilities required to address current and emerging regulatory challenges. Provides leadership to subordinate managers and supervisors and ensures effective and equitable management of the organization.

Become a part of the Department that touches the lives of every American. At the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) you can give back to your community, state, and country, by making a difference in the lives of Americans everywhere! HHS is the principal agency for protecting the health of citizens. Join HHS and help to make our world healthier, safer, and better for all Americans. The Food and Drug Administration is the regulatory, scientific, public health, and consumer protection agency responsible for ensuring that all human and animal drugs, and medical devices are safe and effective, that cosmetics, foods, food additives, drugs and medicated feeds for food producing animals, and radiation emitting devices are safe, and that all such products marketed in the United States are adequately, truthfully and informatively labeled and safely and properly stored, transported, manufactured packaged and regulated. The position is located in the Department of Health and Human Services (DHHS), Food and Drug Administration (FDA), Center for Devices and Radiological Health (CDRH), Office of Science and Engineering Laboratories (OSEL). The mission of the Center for Devices and Radiological Health (CDRH) is to protect and promote public health. CDRH assures that patients and providers have timely and continued access to safe, effective, and high-quality medical devices and safe radiation-emitting products.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Engineering
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence . As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

About the Role:

The Developer Experience (DevX) team is a high-impact group charged with fueling the future of Crusoe’s engineering muscle. We’re responsible for critical developer tools and infrastructure that are used by all of Crusoe engineering. We focus on accelerating development while ensuring we keep a high bar for quality.

We’re looking for a Senior manager who will own multiple charter’s within DevX, in particular our AI remote agent platform, a suite of standard agents (coding, reviewing, maintenance/upgrades) running on that platform and support for our coding harnesses.

You will play a critical role in shaping our technical direction, communicating a strategic vision, and fostering a company-wide culture of engineering excellence. By partnering with stakeholders across the organization, you will define the future state of Crusoe’s evolving software development efforts and eliminate the friction that stands between an engineer and their "flow state." This is a full-time position for a visionary leader who wants to influence the long-term technical objectives of a company aligning the future of computing with the future of the climate.

What You'll Be Working On:

Engineering Acceleration: Partner with the broader organization to build paved paths that engineers love to use. Our paved paths are fast, reliable and broadly adopted across all of engineering.

Toil Elimination: Ruthlessly identify and automate away the friction and repetitive tasks that slow down the development process, keeping Crusoe engineers in a state of high productivity.
Library & Environment Creation: Develop the libraries, tools, and pre-production environments necessary for vetting service APIs and complex microservice interactions.
Ecosystem Integration: Unify internal tooling and vendor services to automate workflows, build operational efficiency, and optimize security across the development stack.
Culture of Quality: Lead efforts to establish a culture of continuous quality delivery that scales seamlessly as our engineering headcount and infrastructure grow.
System Optimization: Work diligently to build efficient systems and processes that serve as a force multiplier for the impact of every engineer around you.

What You'll Bring to the Team:

Experience: Previous experience leading multiple team charters in DevX, including managing other managers
Technical Decision-Making: Expert ability to evaluate technical tradeoffs and understand how infrastructure decisions impact the daily productivity of the end-user (the developer).
Modern Tooling Proficiency: Fluent knowledge of industry-standard AI tooling, build tooling, containerization, and open-source development frameworks.
Workflow Empathy: A demonstrated passion for building empathetic developer and operator workflows that prioritize human productivity.
Cloud-Native Expertise: Professional experience managing or developing within Kubernetes clusters and a deep understanding of container orchestration.
DevOps & Reliability Background: Proven experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Release Engineering, or a similar productivity-focused discipline.
Testing Infrastructure Knowledge: Deep understanding of automated testing infrastructure and how to integrate it into a seamless CI/CD pipeline.
Language & Version Control Mastery: Expertise in modern programming languages (specifically Go) and advanced proficiency in Git-based workflows (GitLab/GitHub).
Mandatory Education: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related analytical field (or equivalent professional experience).

Bonus Points

Strategic Vision: Experience informing long-term company objectives through technical insight and developer-centric advocacy.
AI Platforms: Experience building AI agent platforms for engineering teams
Linux Internals: Hands-on experience with Linux image construction, package building.
Automation Mindset: A background in solving complex, multi-layered technical problems and then successfully automating the resulting solutions.

Benefits:

Competitive compensation and equity packages
Restricted Stock Units
Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs
Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance
Employer contributions to HSA account
Paid parental leave
Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability
Professional development & tuition reimbursement
Mental health & wellness support
Commuter benefits (parking & transit)
Cell phone stipend
401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary
Volunteer time off
Global travel insurance & emergency assistance
Daily meals allowance
Additional perks & programs specific to location

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $250,000 -$300,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.
