Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. Salesforce offers a variety of benefits to help you live well including: time off programs, medical, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, 401(k), and an employee stock purchasing program. jobs.title: Director of Information Technology
jobs.description:
We are seeking a hands-on Director of Information Technology. This role turns fast-moving IT team into a disciplined, well-staffed operation — leading incident response, building routine operational rigor, and securing a Microsoft Azure environment against modern AI-driven threats through Zero Trust architecture and strong day-to-day upkeep.

What We're Looking For

7+ years in IT operations or infrastructure, including 3+ years leading people, major incidents, or service delivery in multi-site or operationally intensive environments.
Strong hands-on networking: routing and switching, VLANs and segmentation, VPN and SD-WAN, warehouse wireless, and firewall policy. Cisco, Meraki, and Palo Alto strongly preferred.
Current, hands-on AI and automation skills (Microsoft 365 Copilot, Power Automate or Copilot Studio, PowerShell or Python), plus a clear grasp of AI risk: data oversharing, sensitivity labels and DLP, and acceptable use. Show us something you've built.
Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Windows Server, identity, and security operations.
A track record of building incident, change, request, asset, and continuity processes, and of managing MSPs and vendors.
Clear communication with executives and frontline teams alike.
Availability for after-hours maintenance, emergency response, and regular inter-island travel.

What You'll Do

Own IT operations and the operating calendar: patching, vulnerability remediation, access reviews, recovery testing, lifecycle planning, and renewals.
Own the network across all sites: SD-WAN, switching, wireless, firewalls, inter-island connectivity, warehouse Wi-Fi, and carriers.
Automate routine work such as onboarding, patching, reporting, and ticket triage, and roll out AI tools like Microsoft 365 Copilot with sound data governance.
Act as incident commander for major disruptions, keep leadership and teams informed, and lead post-incident reviews.
Run practical change management and documentation so no production system depends on one person.
Own resilience: recovery objectives, restoration and failover testing, and business-continuity tabletop exercises.
Develop the Help Desk Specialist, and hold MSP and vendors to clear standards on service quality, risk, and renewals.

Who Thrives Here

jobs.description:
$200,000 - $350,000 USD yearly

Description

About the Role

Virtium is seeking a Senior VP, Technology to help define the next chapter of our technology strategy as we expand from our strong foundation in industrial memory and storage into broader embedded computing, Edge AI, connectivity, and integrated system-level solutions.

This is a highly visible executive role for a senior technology leader who can combine deep technical credibility, customer insight, product vision, and practical business judgment. The Senior VP, Technology will partner directly with the CTO, executive leadership, customers, technology partners, and internal teams to shape where Virtium invests, differentiates, and grows.

About Virtium

Virtium is a Rancho Santa Margarita, California–based designer and manufacturer of high-reliability industrial embedded solutions for customers whose systems must operate consistently in demanding, long-life environments. For more than 25 years, Virtium has supported global OEMs with industrial-grade SSDs, DRAM memory modules, compute and system-on-module solutions, AI accelerator modules, connectivity modules, and supporting software.

Our solutions are used in applications across networking and telecommunications, industrial automation, aerospace and defense, medical, transportation, rugged computing, Industrial IoT, and other mission-critical embedded markets where reliability, lifecycle stability, qualification, and supply continuity matter.

Why This Role Matters

Virtium’s customers are navigating increasing complexity across embedded computing, Edge AI workloads, memory and storage requirements, semiconductor transitions, security expectations, and long product lifecycles. The Senior VP, Technology will help identify where customer requirements, emerging technologies, supplier roadmaps, and market opportunities intersect—and translate those insights into differentiated solutions, strategic partnerships, and scalable product opportunities.

The right leader will have the chance to influence Virtium’s technology direction at a meaningful stage of growth, with direct access to executive decision-making and a clear connection between strategy, customer need, product development, and market impact.

What You’ll Lead

Reporting to the CTO, the Senior VP, Technology will serve as Virtium’s senior technology strategist and trusted technical voice with customers, suppliers, partners, and internal teams. This leader will guide through technical credibility, strategic judgment, collaboration, and cross-functional influence while partnering closely with engineering leadership responsible for development execution.

Key Areas of Impact

Customer and Market Strategy: Build trusted-advisor relationships with strategic OEM customers, understand their embedded system architecture and future requirements, and identify where Virtium can create differentiated technical and commercial value.
Technology and Product Roadmap: Define and maintain Virtium’s long-term roadmap across industrial SSDs, DRAM memory, compute/SOM platforms, AI accelerator modules, connectivity modules, and related software-enabled solutions.
Technology Ecosystem Leadership: Develop strategic relationships with semiconductor manufacturers, processor and controller suppliers, memory and NAND partners, AI accelerator providers, connectivity partners, and other key technology ecosystem partners.
Architecture and Technical Direction: Guide major platform, architecture, and technology decisions across hardware, firmware, software, edge workload performance, system integration, thermal and power constraints, reliability, qualification, validation, and lifecycle requirements.
Executive Alignment and Growth: Align executive, commercial, product, engineering, operations, and supply chain teams around focused technology priorities that support customer value, differentiation, revenue growth, manufacturability, and time to market.

Ideal Candidate Profile

Executive-level technology leader with 15+ years of relevant experience in embedded systems, edge computing, memory, storage, semiconductors, computing hardware, connectivity, industrial hardware, or complex hardware/software platforms.
Strong customer-facing Senior VP, Technology, VP Engineering, Chief Architect, Distinguished Engineer, Fellow, or senior technology leadership background with credibility across OEM customers, engineering teams, suppliers, and executive stakeholders.
Deep understanding of how to balance innovation with reliability, lifecycle stability, manufacturability, qualification, security, performance, and supply continuity in demanding embedded or mission-critical environments.
Proven ability to translate customer and market insight into technology roadmaps, scalable product opportunities, strategic partnerships, and practical execution priorities.
Comfortable operating in a hands-on, collaborative, growth-oriented environment where influence, clarity, judgment, and customer proximity matter.
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, computer science, or a related technical discipline

Location and Logistics

Reports to: Chief Technology Officer
Compensation: Total compensation range of $200-350K. Competitive and based on experience and alignment with the role; bonus eligible.
Location: Onsite, executive leadership role based at Virtium’s headquarters in Rancho Santa Margarita, California, where close collaboration with executive, engineering, product, and operations teams is central to the role’s impact.
Schedule: Full-time, Monday through Friday.

jobs.description:
Your opportunity

At Schwab, you’re empowered to make an impact on your career. Here, innovative thought meets creative problem solving, helping us “challenge the status quo” and transform the finance industry together.

We believe in the importance of in-office collaboration and fully intend for the selected candidate for this role to work on site in the specified location(s).

The Schwab Technology Services (STS) Research & Development team explores emerging technologies and turns them into practical capabilities that create measurable value across Schwab. We operate at the intersection of innovation and execution—rapidly testing ideas, partnering across the enterprise, and scaling what works.

The Blockchain Platform Architect will define and guide the architecture for enterprise-grade blockchain and digital asset platforms within the Technology Incubation organization. Reporting to the Director of Technology, this role will translate emerging blockchain opportunities into secure, scalable, and operationally resilient platform designs that can move from experimentation to enterprise adoption.

This architect will partner closely with engineering, cloud, security, enterprise architecture, risk, legal, compliance, product, and business stakeholders to design platforms that balance innovation speed with Schwab’s standards for security, resiliency, governance, and client trust.

Key Responsibilities

Own the target-state architecture and technical roadmap for blockchain and digital asset platform capabilities, including platform components, service boundaries, integration patterns, APIs, data models, and operational controls.
Design secure, scalable, fault-tolerant distributed systems that support experimentation, pilot delivery, and production use.
Evaluate blockchain protocols, node infrastructure, custody patterns, smart contract frameworks, interoperability models, and blockchain data access strategies.
Partner with engineering teams to guide implementation, review designs, resolve complex technical tradeoffs, and establish reusable platform patterns.
Collaborate with security, risk, legal, compliance, and enterprise architecture teams to ensure platform designs meet enterprise controls, regulatory expectations, defense-in-depth principles, and operational resilience requirements.
Define architecture documentation, reference models, decision records, design standards, and graduation criteria needed to move capabilities from prototype to sustainable ownership.
Serve as a technical advisor to the Director of Technology and executive stakeholders by translating blockchain architecture choices into business value, risk implications, investment needs, and adoption paths.

Success Measures

Blockchain platform initiatives have clear architecture direction, reusable patterns, documented tradeoffs, and measurable progress toward incubation milestones.
Security, risk, compliance, and operational readiness requirements are built into the platform design early rather than added late in the delivery lifecycle.
Engineering teams can move faster through common platform standards, reference architectures, reusable services, and clear decision records.
The Director of Technology and executive stakeholders have clear visibility into platform maturity, technical risks, dependencies, and decisions required for enterprise adoption.

What you have

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related technical field (advanced degree a plus).
10+ years of experience in software engineering including delivering platforms, or complex technology initiatives.
Strong technical foundation in modern architectures, cloud-native development, and engineering best practices; ability to guide technical decisions without needing to be the primary implementer.
Demonstrated ability to influence across organizational boundaries and collaborate effectively with Product, Risk, Legal/Compliance, Security, and business stakeholders.
Excellent communication skills—able to align leaders, and convey technical tradeoffs clearly.
Deep experience designing and operating enterprise platforms, distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, APIs, event-driven patterns, observability, resiliency, and DevSecOps practices.
Strong understanding of blockchain fundamentals, distributed ledger technologies, consensus mechanisms, cryptography, smart contracts, tokenization concepts, node operations, custody models, and digital asset transaction flows.
Experience applying security and control patterns such as authentication, authorization, encryption, key management, secrets management, secure coding, vulnerability management, monitoring, and incident response readiness.
Ability to work across ambiguous, emerging technology spaces while producing practical architecture artifacts, decision frameworks, and implementation guidance.
Clear communication skills with the ability to influence engineers, architects, product partners, risk stakeholders, and senior leaders.

In addition to the salary range, this role is also eligible for bonus or incentive opportunities.

At Schwab, you’re empowered to shape your future. We champion your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture of trust and collaboration—so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our Hybrid Work and Flexibility approach balances our ongoing commitment to workplace flexibility, serving our clients, and our strong belief in the value of being together in person on a regular basis.

jobs.description:
The Estée Lauder Companies Inc.
is one of the world’s leading manufacturers, marketers, and sellers of quality skin care, makeup, fragrance, and hair care products, and is a steward of luxury and prestige brands globally. The company’s products are sold in approximately 150 countries and territories under brand names including: Estée Lauder, Aramis, Clinique, Lab Series, Origins, M·A·C, La Mer, Bobbi Brown Cosmetics, Aveda, Jo Malone London, Bumble and bumble, Darphin Paris, TOM FORD, Smashbox, AERIN Beauty, Le Labo, Editions de Parfums Frédéric Malle, GLAMGLOW, KILIAN PARIS, Too Faced, Dr.Jart+, the DECIEM family of brands, including The Ordinary and NIOD, and BALMAIN Beauty.

Description

The Technical Executive Director, SAP Basis & Platform Operations, is responsible for ensuring the stability, security, and performance of the current global SAP environment.

This role leads the SAP Basis organization with accountability for 24x7 operations, platform lifecycle management, and technical architecture, with a strong focus on evolving the landscape toward S/4HANA, RISE, and cloud-first delivery models.

This role will drive the transformation from traditional SAP Basis operations to a modern platform engineering capability, enabling scalability, automation, and improved service delivery. While maintaining operational excellence across ECC and integrated NetWeaver platforms, this role will accelerate the adoption of cloud-based services, hybrid architectures, SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC) and SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) capabilities.

Partnering with Enterprise Architecture, SAP functional/engineering leadership, and infrastructure teams, this position will define and execute a multi-year transformation roadmap, aligning SAP platform capabilities with long-term business strategy. Success in this role requires the ability to lead through change, operate within shared responsibility models (RISE), and balance current-state reliability with future-state innovation.

Key Roles & Responsibilities

SAP Platform Strategy & Transformation

Help define and execute the SAP platform strategy, aligning to S/4HANA, RISE, and cloud-first architecture principles
Develop and maintain a multi-year transformation roadmap, including S/4HANA readiness and adoption planning
Partner with enterprise architecture and SAP leadership to drive innovation and future-state platform capabilities

Global SAP Basis Operations Leadership

Lead the global SAP Basis organization, ensuring reliable 24x7 production support across all SAP environments
Own service delivery performance, including SLAs, incident management, problem resolution, and change control
Drive evolution from traditional Basis operations to a platform engineering and service-oriented model

Key Roles & Responsibilities (Continued)

Platform Lifecycle & Technical Engineering

Oversee SAP platform lifecycle activities, including upgrades, patching, migrations, and transformation initiatives
Lead technical execution of modernization efforts, including HANA optimization and S/4 readiness activities
Ensure optimal performance, capacity planning, and system tuning across SAP landscapes

RISE, Cloud & Hybrid Infrastructure Management

Lead SAP platform operations across RISE, cloud (Azure), and on-premise environments
Define and manage operating models within shared responsibility frameworks with SAP
Drive infrastructure optimization, including cost management, scalability, and performance

Key Roles & Responsibilities (Continued)

Future-State Enablement (S/4HANA, RISE, BTP)

Establish foundational capabilities required for S/4HANA transformation and cloud adoption
Enable adoption of SAP BTP services, integration capabilities, and platform extensibility
Lead transition to modern tools such as SAP BDC, Cloud ALM and advanced monitoring frameworks

Vendor & Partner Management

Manage strategic relationships with SAP, cloud providers, and third-party service partners
Govern service delivery across a multi-vendor ecosystem, ensuring accountability and performance
Coordinate effectively within SAP-managed and hybrid cloud service models

Key Roles & Responsibilities (Continued)

Risk, Security & Compliance

Ensure SAP platform compliance with security standards, audit requirements, and regulatory expectations
Oversee vulnerability management, patching strategies, and risk mitigation efforts
Ensure readiness for disaster recovery and business continuity scenarios

Leadership & Talent Development

Mentor and develop talent aligned to modern SAP and cloud capabilities

Qualifications

Leadership & Experience

10+ years of experience in SAP Basis, platform engineering, or SAP technical operations within large-scale, global environments
5+ years of leadership experience managing SAP Basis teams and/or managed service providers
Proven track record of leading SAP platform transformation initiatives, including modernization and cloud adoption
Experience operating in complex, highly integrated SAP landscapes, preferably supporting a single global instance or similarly scaled environment

Core SAP Technical Expertise

Deep expertise in SAP Basis administration across ECC and NetWeaver-based platforms, including BW, PI/PO, Portal, and Solution Manager
Strong experience with SAP HANA databases, including performance tuning, system optimization, and migration support
Demonstrated experience leading or supporting major SAP lifecycle events (upgrades, migrations, system refreshes, Unicode/HANA conversions, etc.)
Strong understanding of transport management, system architecture, and cross-system integration dependencies

Qualifications (Continued)

Cloud, Hybrid & Emerging SAP Capabilities

Hands-on experience supporting SAP workloads in cloud environments (Azure preferred), including infrastructure design, networking, and performance optimization
Experience with or direct involvement in S/4HANA environments and migration planning/execution
Strong familiarity with SAP RISE (Private or Public Cloud) operating models, including shared responsibility and SAP-managed services
Working knowledge of hybrid SAP landscapes, including connectivity (VPN, ExpressRoute), identity integration, and cloud-to-on-premise integration patterns
Experience with SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), including integration, extensibility, or data services strongly preferred

Architecture & Strategic Capability

Ability to define and evolve target-state SAP platform architecture aligned to cloud-first and S/4HANA strategies
Experience partnering with Enterprise Architecture to define multi-year roadmaps and transformation strategies
Strong understanding of infrastructure design, capacity planning, and system scalability across hybrid and cloud environments

Qualifications (Continued)

Operational Excellence & Governance

Deep understanding of ITIL-based service management processes (Incident, Problem, Change Management)
Proven experience modernizing operations through automation, standardization, and service optimization
Experience implementing or supporting modern monitoring, observability, and performance management frameworks
Strong focus on automation and operational efficiency within SAP platform management

Vendor & Stakeholder Management

Experience managing and governing third-party service providers and SAP support relationships
Ability to operate effectively in a multi-vendor, globally distributed delivery model, including SAP-managed cloud services
Strong communication skills with the ability to engage technical teams, business stakeholders, and executive leadership

Education & Certifications

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
SAP certifications (Basis, NetWeaver, HANA, or S/4HANA) preferred
Cloud certifications (Azure and/or SAP BTP) strongly preferred

Your Work

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Data Engineering
jobs.description:
JLL Technologies is a specialized group within JLL. At JLL Technologies, our mission is to bring technological innovation to commercial real estate. We deliver unparalleled digital advisory, implementation, and services solutions to organizations globally. Our goal is to leverage technology to increase the value and liquidity of the world’s buildings, while enhancing the productivity and happiness of those that occupy them.

The Data Engineering team builds and operates the data products and pipelines that power JLL’s Corporate Functions, including areas such as finance, HR, Legal, Compliance and shared services. Working on the Enterprise Data Platform (EDP), we turn internal enterprise data into trusted, governed, and increasingly real-time assets that leaders and teams across the firm rely on for reporting, planning, and operational decisions.

What this job involves

As Senior Data Engineering Manager, you will lead multiple related scrum teams of data engineers responsible for Corporate Functions data – from ingestion and streaming pipelines through curated, governed data products. Your teams own the reliability, quality, and timeliness of the data that underpins enterprise reporting, financial and workforce analytics, and shared-services operations.

You will own delivery and direction for the Corporate Functions data engineering function: setting priorities across teams, allocating resources, guiding technical design, and partnering with product, analytics, and business leaders to translate needs into a clear roadmap. You will be accountable for team outcomes, data quality standards, and the continuous improvement of engineering practices.

The ideal candidate blends the technical credibility of a Lead Data Engineer – hands-on depth in Python, Azure, and streaming architectures – with proven people leadership, and the ability to build trust with senior business stakeholders.

What you’ll get to do

As Senior Data Engineering Manager, your “customers” include leaders and teams in Finance, HR, Legal, Compliance and other Corporate Functions, data analysts and BI teams, product managers, and fellow platform and governance teams across JLL Technologies. Your mission is to lead the Corporate Functions data engineering function – defining the roadmap, operating model, and quality standards that make data trusted, timely, and reusable.

This is an opportunity to shape how streaming and governed data enable faster, better-informed decisions across the enterprise – and to grow a high-performing engineering organization while doing it.

Key responsibilities

Technical Leadership:
Provide hands-on technical direction for batch and streaming data pipelines built on Azure, Python, and Spark. Guide architecture and design reviews, set engineering standards for reusable frameworks, and stay close to critical technical risks.

Real-Time and Streaming Data Delivery:
Lead the design and operation of event-driven pipelines using technologies such as Kafka and Spark Streaming, so that financial, workforce, and operational data reaches downstream consumers with the latency and reliability the business requires.

Data Governance and Quality:
Own data quality, lineage, cataloging, and stewardship practices for Corporate Functions data domains, including sensitive finance and HR data. Define measurable quality standards, automate validation and monitoring in pipelines, and partner with enterprise governance and security teams to ensure compliance with JLL data policies and access controls.

Delivery Management:
Set priorities and manage execution across multiple scrum teams. Balance roadmap commitments, technical debt, and operational demands; maintain predictable delivery; and adapt plans as business needs evolve.

Platform Alignment and Modernization:
Align team deliverables with the Enterprise Data Platform strategy. Drive adoption of platform standards, ingestion patterns, and cloud-native services, and contribute to modernization of legacy data assets.

Reliability and Operational Excellence:
Establish CI/CD, observability, and incident management practices that keep pipelines healthy. Ensure teams meet service-level expectations and learn from production issues through blameless reviews.

Cross-Functional Leadership:
Collaborate with product, analytics, data science, platform, security, and governance teams to deliver end-to-end data solutions. Resolve dependencies, negotiate shared priorities, and keep teams aligned on outcomes.

Team Development and Mentorship:
Recruit, coach, and retain strong engineers and team leads. Set clear expectations, provide regular feedback, build career growth paths, and foster a culture of inclusion, ownership, and continuous learning.

Stakeholder Management:
Build trusted relationships with Corporate Functions business and technology leaders. Communicate status, risks, and trade-offs clearly, manage expectations on scope and timelines, and ensure engineering work maps to business value.

Resource and Budget Planning:
Partner with leadership on headcount, vendor, and cloud cost planning for your teams, optimizing talent utilization and cost efficiency across products and initiatives.

Who you are

You are a people-first engineering leader who has grown from strong hands-on data engineering roots. You earn credibility with engineers by understanding the technical detail – from distributed processing to data modeling trade-offs – while inspiring them through clear direction, coaching, and high standards. You navigate competing priorities with composure, explain complex topics plainly to executives, and hold yourself accountable for both team outcomes and the quality of the data your teams deliver. You are energized by turning ambiguous business needs into reliable, governed data products.

Required Qualifications

People management: 2+ years directly managing data engineers or technical individual contributors; experience setting priorities, allocating work, and coaching teams; managing managers is not required.
Data engineering experience: 7+ years in data engineering, including multiple large and complex projects delivered end to end.
Technical depth: Advanced Python and SQL; strong experience with Azure data services and distributed processing (e.g., Spark/PySpark); experience building reusable frameworks.
Streaming: Hands-on experience designing or leading real-time data pipelines with Kafka, Spark Streaming, or equivalent technologies.
Data governance and quality: Working knowledge of data quality frameworks, lineage, metadata management, and data governance practices.
Delivery: Experience managing or training teams of data engineers and setting priorities across multiple data engineering workstreams in an agile environment.
Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical and business stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Experience with corporate data domains such as finance, HR, or shared services (e.g., ERP, HRIS, or enterprise reporting data), or in commercial real estate.
Experience with NoSQL, graph, or multi-model databases (e.g., CosmosDB, MongoDB) and complex cross-system integrations.
Familiarity with data cataloging and governance tooling, and with CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code practices.
Experience with modern lakehouse or data platform architectures and enterprise data platforms.
Exposure to applying AI/ML or LLM-based capabilities to data engineering and data quality workflows.

Key attributes

Leadership:
Builds and retains strong teams; delegates effectively while staying close to critical technical risks.

Stakeholder Partnership:
Navigates competing priorities with poise; negotiates scope and timelines with data-driven rationale.

Judgment:
Makes sound trade-offs among quality, speed, cost, and risk.

Communication:
Explains technical concepts clearly to executives; listens for business constraints that should shape engineering decisions.

Ownership:
Accountable for team outcomes, platform health, and continuous improvement of engineering practices.

jobs.title: Director, Software & Firmware Engineering
jobs.description:
Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form!

In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by TIME as a “Best Invention”, MIT Technology Review as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and Fast Company as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia.

Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing - might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.

Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.

Role Description

Form Energy is seeking a Director of Software & Firmware Engineering to lead the organization responsible for the software and firmware that operate our energy storage products. Reporting to the Senior Director of Software Engineering & Test Engineering, this leader will oversee embedded software and firmware, the applications used to commission and service our products, and the engineering support required throughout development and the deployed lifecycle. You will bring together product software, firmware, lifecycle applications, and operational support into a cohesive engineering organization with clear ownership and strong technical discipline. This is an opportunity to shape the architecture, teams, and operating model behind a complex, software-enabled energy product with meaningful impact on the electric grid.

Relocation assistance is available.

What You'll Do

Lead and develop engineering managers, senior technical leaders, individual contributors, and contractors across embedded software, firmware, systems engineering, manufacturing software, and fleet operations.
Establish an integrated engineering strategy across requirements, architecture, reusable product platforms, firmware delivery, deployment, and operational support.
Drive a requirements-first and tooling-first approach to software development, safety, security, compliance, and technical evidence.
Build reusable software and firmware platforms spanning operating systems, middleware, networking, device runtime, simulation, build systems, release tooling, deployment interfaces, and secure OTA delivery mechanisms.
Lead the organization responsible for product firmware delivery, integration, debugging, release readiness, system bring-up, rapid prototyping, fixtures, and supporting engineering tools.
Oversee the production rollout and operation of deployed software, including fleet observability, production SRE, OTA execution, commissioning and service applications, incident response, and long-term fleet reliability.
Ensure commissioning, service, field, product, and test organizations receive effective software and firmware support throughout the product lifecycle.
Develop integrated staffing and execution plans, identify technical and organizational risks early, and drive clear prioritization decisions across competing product needs.
Partner closely with Product Management, hardware, controls, manufacturing, field operations, regulatory teams, Engineering Automation, and Product Quality.
Build a strong engineering culture centered on accountability, technical rigor, rapid learning, maintainability, modularity, reuse, and long-term fleet operability.

What You'll Bring

15+ years of experience in software, firmware, embedded systems, or product systems engineering, including significant experience leading managers and multidisciplinary engineering organizations.
Demonstrated success delivering complex software-enabled physical products through architecture, implementation, integration, verification, production, deployment, and field operation.
Strong technical depth in embedded software and firmware, operating systems, middleware, networking, distributed systems, and hardware/software interfaces.
Experience establishing requirements, systems architecture, technical governance, verification strategy, and engineering processes across multiple teams.
Proven ability to recruit, develop, and retain strong engineering managers and technical leaders while building clear organizational ownership and accountability.
Demonstrated ability to translate product priorities into staffing, investment, sequencing, and delivery decisions, make difficult tradeoffs, and communicate technical and organizational risks to executive and cross-functional audiences.

Humanity is a cornerstone of Form Energy’s culture, and we make sure our compensation and benefits reflect that. Form Energy offers competitive salaries, stock options, and a holistic benefits package to ensure all employees have what they need to thrive while working here.

When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees - and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents. This starts from day one. We also offer at least 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents (up to 20 weeks for birthing parents), and generous vacation policies to give employees time to recharge when needed.

To build America’s energy future, we need everyone at the table. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply to our open jobs.

If you may require reasonable accommodations to participate in our interview process, please contact accommodations@formenergy.com. Requests for accommodations will be treated with discretion.

Form Energy is committed to maintaining the privacy of our applicants. Please be aware that we will never
solicit sensitive personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank account details during the recruiting or hiring process.

Great Day Improvements - Senior Director, Infrastructure & Operations

Full-Time, exempt.

What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity?

At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.

Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.

Position Summary

Illumina's BioInsight Platform Core is the software foundation on which customers connect instruments, manage samples and projects, store and move data, run analysis workflows, and explore results — across cloud and on-prem deployments. As Director of Software Technical Product Management, BioInsight Platform Core Product, you own the product strategy, roadmap, and delivery partnership for Platform Core: the application-facing capabilities historically delivered as Illumina Connected Analytics (ICA) and related platform surfaces.

You own instrument connectivity, data storage and data movement, workflow / pipeline execution, sample and project management, notebooks and interactive analysis, platform user experience, and APIs / developer experience — the product capabilities that make BioInsight Platform the durable home for Illumina software applications. You partner tightly with other software product leaders, as well as stakeholders across Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Finance, and Legal.

Scope of Responsibilities

Own BioInsight Platform Core product end-to-end: vision, multi-release roadmap, requirements quality, and release readiness for core platform capabilities
Lead a team of software technical product managers; hire, coach, and set the bar for platform product excellence
Serve as the primary product partner to platform engineering leadership on architecture bets, technical debt, reliability, performance, and security of core capabilities
Define outcome metrics for platform success: availability, time-to-first-analysis, workflow success rate, storage and data-movement reliability, notebook / interactive-analysis adoption, API adoption, and support burden
Ensure Platform Core meets enterprise and regulated-customer expectations for the capabilities it owns (security, privacy, auditability, quality-system interfaces where applicable)
Navigate ambiguity across a platform that serves many applications; create a coherent product narrative and prioritization framework
Represent BioInsight Platform Core in BioInsight leadership forums; escalate tradeoffs with clear recommendations

Responsibilities

Establish a multi-year roadmap for BioInsight Platform Core with clear problem statements and success metrics
Own product requirements for core platform capabilities, including: Instrument connectivity — sequencer and lab instrument connection, run data ingress, status, and operational reliability Data storage and data movement — customer data stores, import/export, retention/lifecycle behaviors that affect product experience (commercial storage packaging partners with Commercialization) Workflow and pipeline execution — defining, launching, monitoring, and operating analysis workflows at scale Sample and project management — organizing biological and analysis context that applications and workflows depend on Notebooks and interactive analysis — exploratory / interactive compute experiences on platform data Platform UX and APIs — console experience, developer surfaces, and integration contracts used by applications and customers
Partner with engineering leaders and architects to land technical bets safely; manage quality, cost, performance, and time tradeoffs
Lead customer and field discovery on core-product friction (instrument connection, storage/workflow failures, notebook UX, API gaps, cross-application platform gaps); synthesize into prioritized bets
Align with application TPMs (DRAGEN, Oncology / ICI, Genetic Disease, Multiomics, Orchestration) so Platform Core investments unlock portfolio-level outcomes
Partner with the Commercialization Director at the boundary where core capabilities meet commercial systems (e.g., storage tiers that are sold, workflow compute that is metered) — Commercialization owns tenancy, IAM, entitlements, usage metering, and billing; Core owns the product capability customers use
Define and review launch and post-market quality plans for Platform Core releases; engage Quality/Security/Privacy as needed
Instrument core capabilities for product telemetry; drive iteration loops that improve adoption and reduce support load
Support strategic customer engagements where Platform Core architecture, roadmap, or reliability is decisive
Build and develop the core product team; raise the bar on PRDs, documentation, and cross-functional working agreements

Listed responsibilities are an essential, but not exhaustive list, of the usual duties associated with the position. Changes to individual responsibilities may occur due to business needs.

Experience / Education

Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 18 years of related experience in a technical field (computer science, bioinformatics, engineering, life sciences, or related) or equivalent experience; advanced degree a plus
Typically 12+ years of progressive experience in product management for scientific, data, or analysis platforms (workflow/pipeline systems, data platforms, instrument-to-cloud software, or developer-facing platforms), with 5+ years leading managers or senior ICs
Track record shipping platform capabilities at scale — e.g., storage/data services, workflow orchestration or pipeline execution, notebooks / interactive compute, instrument or device connectivity, or APIs used by multiple consuming applications
Experience in life sciences, health tech, genomics, or regulated software strongly preferred; prior ICA, BaseSpace, or equivalent genomics-platform experience is a significant plus
Comfortable discussing architecture, APIs, data models, SLAs, and security with engineering leaders
Strong executive communication skills; ability to create clarity under ambiguity
Familiarity with AWS, Azure, or GCP and with hybrid / on-prem deployment models is a plus

jobs.description:
Overview

Great minds meet great challenges.

Ready to build what’s next?

At PNNL, our core capabilities are divided among major departments that we refer to as Directorates within the Lab, focused on a specific area of scientific research or other function, with its own leadership team and dedicated budget.

Our Science & Technology directorates include National Security, Integrated Discovery Sciences, and Energy and Environment. In addition, we have an Environmental Molecular Sciences Laboratory, a Department of Energy, Office of Science user facility housed on the PNNL campus.

The National Security Directorate (NSD) drives science-based, mission-focused solutions to take on complex, real-world threats to our nation and the world.

The AI and Data Analytics Division, part of NSD, combines profound domain expertise and creative integration of advanced hardware and software to deliver computational solutions that address complex data and analytic challenges. Working in multidisciplinary teams, we connect foundational research to engineering to operations, providing the tools to innovate quickly and field results faster. Our strengths are integrated across the data analytics lifecycle, from data acquisition and management to analysis and decision support.

Event Details

Our hiring event will take place during the weeks of October 12th to November 13th.

Selected candidates may be invited to participate in virtual and onsite interviews during this timeframe and will be contacted directly with scheduling details.

This role is performed full-time onsite at the PNNL campus in Richland, WA or Seattle, WA.

Responsibilities

With new projects and expanding programs, our AI and Data Analytics Division offers opportunities to advance cutting-edge research and build solutions for critical national security missions. Join a team of more than 400 data scientists, software engineers, mathematicians, and human-centered computing researchers turning ambitious ideas into real-world capabilities.

We're hiring across three complementary chief engineering tracks
, and we're looking for people who want to own something meaningful end-to-end: from the platform beneath it, to the systems that power it, to the experience humans actually touch.

Skills We’re Seeking

DevSecOps and Platform Engineering: Design and build scalable AI platforms, cloud-native infrastructure, containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines, IaC, real-time data stream architectures, and reliable, secure production systems. We are particularly interested in engineers with strong Python expertise and significant experience in DevOps, platform engineering, site reliability engineering, distributed systems, telemetry and observability, security, and automated software delivery.
AI Systems & Data Platform Software Engineers: Push the boundaries of agentic AI systems characterized by autonomy, adaptability, reasoning, collaboration, and effective tool use. We are seeking experienced software engineers and nationally recognized technical leaders who have designed and deployed agentic AI systems and large-scale data platforms in real-world environments. Relevant expertise includes large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, multi-step reasoning, autonomous decision workflows, model and data orchestration, production-quality AI systems, and designing and operating petabyte-scale ETL/ELT pipelines. Senior candidates may also shape research directions, lead multidisciplinary R&D programs, develop external partnerships, and mentor AI scientists and engineers.

Learn more about the PNNL AI and Data Analytics Division.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

PhD and 5 years of relevant experience -OR-
MS/MA and 7 years of relevant experience -OR-
BS/BA and 9 years of relevant experience -OR-
AA and 18 years of relevant experience -OR-
HS/GED and 20 years of relevant experience.
Relevant experience is defined as Software Engineering experience in designing, architecting, programming, deploying, and automating software solutions in support of scientific research or consumer digital product development.

Current, hands-on software development experience using Python.

Hazardous Working Conditions/Environment

Not applicable.

Additional Information

This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a federal security clearance.

A security clearance background investigation includes review of your employment, education, financial, and criminal history, as well as interviews with you and your personal references, neighbors, and co-workers to determine trustworthiness, reliability, and loyalty to the United States. The investigation also examines your foreign connections, drug and alcohol use, foreign influence, and overall conduct.

Requirements

U.S. Citizenship
Background Investigation: Applicants selected will be subject to a Federal background investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified matter in accordance with 10 CFR 710, Appendix B.
Drug Testing: All Security Clearance positions are Testing Designated Positions, which means that the applicant selected for hire is subject to pre-employment drug testing, and post-employment random drug testing. In addition, applicants must be able to demonstrate non-use of illegal drugs, including marijuana, for the 12 consecutive months preceding completion of the requisite Questionnaire for National Security Positions (QNSP).

Note: Applicants will be considered ineligible for security clearance processing by the U.S. Department of Energy if non-use of illegal drugs, including marijuana, for 12 months cannot be demonstrated.

“Referral Eligible”

Testing Designated Position

This position is a Testing Designated Position (TDP). The candidate selected for this position will be subject to pre-employment and random drug testing for illegal drugs, including marijuana, consistent with the Controlled Substances Act and the PNNL Workplace Substance Abuse Program.

About PNNL

Pacific Northwest National Laboratory (PNNL) is a world-class research institution powered by a highly educated, diverse workforce committed to the values of Integrity, Creativity, Collaboration, Impact, and Courage. Every year, scores of dynamic, driven people come to PNNL to work with renowned researchers on meaningful science, innovations and outcomes for the U.S. Department of Energy and other sponsors; here is your chance to be one of them!

At PNNL, you will find an exciting research environment and excellent benefits including health insurance, and flexible work schedules. PNNL is located in eastern Washington State—the dry side of Washington known for its stellar outdoor recreation and affordable cost of living. The Lab’s campus is only a 45-minute flight (or ~3 hour drive) from Seattle or Portland, and is serviced by the convenient PSC airport, connected to 8 major hubs.

Commitment to Excellence and Equal Employment Opportunity

Our laboratory is committed to fostering a work environment where all individuals are treated with fairness and respect while solving critical challenges in fundamental sciences, national security, and energy resiliency. We are an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

Pacific Northwest National Laboratory (PNNL) is an Equal Opportunity Employer. PNNL considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information (including family medical history), protected veteran status, and any other status or characteristic protected by federal, state, and/or local laws.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures and in employment. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, contact us at careers@pnnl.gov.

Drug Free Workplace

PNNL is committed to a drug-free workplace supported by Workplace Substance Abuse Program (WSAP) and complies with federal laws prohibiting the possession and use of illegal drugs.

If you are offered employment at PNNL, you must pass a drug test prior to commencing employment. PNNL complies with federal law regarding illegal drug use. Under federal law, marijuana remains an illegal drug. If you test positive for any illegal controlled substance, including marijuana, your offer of employment will be withdrawn.

Security, Credentialing, And Eligibility Requirements

As a national laboratory, PNNL is responsible for adhering to the Homeland Security Presidential Directive 12 (HSPD-12) and Department of Energy (DOE) Order 473.1A, which require new employees to obtain and maintain a HSPD-12 Personal Identify Verification (PIV) Credential. To obtain this credential, new employees must successfully complete the applicable tier of federal background investigation post hire and receive a favorable federal adjudication. The tier of federal background investigation will be determined by job duties and national security or public trust responsibilities associated with the job. All tiers of investigation include a declaration of illegal drug activities, including use, supply, possession, or manufacture within the last 1 to 7 years (depending on the applicable tier of investigation). Illegal drug activities include marijuana and cannabis derivatives, which are still considered illegal under federal law, regardless of state laws.

For Foreign National Candidates

If you have not resided in the U.S. for three consecutive years, you are not eligible for the PIV credential and instead will need to obtain a favorable Local Site Specific Only (LSSO) Federal risk determination to maintain employment. Once you meet the three-year residency requirement thereafter, you will be required to obtain a PIV credential to maintain employment. The tier of federal background investigation required to obtain the PIV credential will be determined by job duties at the time you become eligible for the PIV credential.

Mandatory Requirements

Please be aware that the Department of Energy (DOE) prohibits DOE employees and contractors from having any affiliation with the foreign government of a country DOE has identified as a “country of risk” without explicit approval by DOE and Battelle. If you are offered a position at PNNL and currently have any affiliation with the government of one of these countries, you will be required to disclose this information and recuse yourself of that affiliation or receive approval from DOE and Battelle prior to your first day of employment.

Rockstar Rewards

Employees and their families are offered medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, robust telehealth care options, several mental health benefits, free wellness coaching, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, basic life insurance, disability insurance*, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, tuition assistance, relocation, backup childcare, legal benefits, supplemental parental bonding leave, surrogacy and adoption assistance, and fertility support. Employees are automatically enrolled in our company-funded pension plan* and may enroll in our 401 (k) savings plan with company match*. Employees may accrue up to 120 vacation hours per year and may receive ten paid holidays per year.

Research Associates excluded.
All benefits are dependent upon eligibility.

This approach is applicable to all positions, with the exception of positions governed by collective bargaining agreements and certain limited-term positions which have specific pay rules.

new_jobs.title: VP-TECHNOLOGY PORTFOLIO-CTO
new_jobs.description:
The Vice President / Chief Technology Officer (VP/CTO) is an executive leadership role responsible for the organization’s enterprise technology strategy, architecture, infrastructure, and operations, enabling Premier Health’s digital health transformation ambitions. Reporting to the Chief Digital Information Officer (CDIO), this individual identifies key emerging trends and technologies, evolves the architecture to support new and emerging technologies, modernizes the infrastructure, and ensures the reliable, secure, and efficient operation of all technology platforms and services supporting business, clinical, and operational objectives.

The VP/CTO acts as both a technology visionary and an operational leader, balancing long-term digital transformation initiatives with day-to-day technology service delivery. This individual provides leadership to enterprise architects, senior product managers, technology specialists, and professionals across Technology Infrastructure, Technology Operations Management, and IT Service Management (ITSM). As a member of the Senior Digital Health and Technology Leadership team, the VP/CTO drives technology innovation, transformation, and technical operations; leads Agile/DevOps teams; leads cloud transformation; and partners with clinical, business, and informatics leaders to ensure technology solutions meet end-user needs and support a modern, patient-centered, high-performing health system.

Scope/Span Of Control

Enterprise-wide accountability for technology strategy, architecture, infrastructure, technology operations, service desk/desktop support, and IT service management across all Premier Health facilities and lines of business. Key areas of responsibility include but are not limited to: multi-site technology operations, hosting (including data center, co-location and cloud), all LAN and WAN network services, server and storge strategy and operations, desktop engineering and service delivery, service desk operations and IT Service Management (ITSM) standards and strategy for the department.

Education

Minimum Level of Education Required:
Bachelor’s degree

Type of Degree:
Bachelor of Science or Bachelor of Arts

Area of Study or Major:
Health Care Administration, Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science Management, or a related engineering/technical discipline

Preferred Educational Qualifications:
Master’s degree (MBA, MHA, MIS, or related field)

Position Specific Testing Requirement:
N/A

Licensure/Certification/Registration

None required. Preferred: ITIL, PMP, Lean Six Sigma/Organizational Change Management (OCM), or relevant technical certifications (e.g., cloud, cybersecurity, network).

Experience

Minimum Level of Experience Required:
10+ years of progressive technology leadership experience, including at least 5 years in a senior IT leadership role

Prior Job Title or Occupational Experience:
Technology Management, CIO, CTO, VP or Director of Technology/Infrastructure

Prior Specific Functional Responsibilities:
Innovation, Entrepreneurship, Operations Leadership, IT Leadership, Digital Leadership, Infrastructure/Technology Operations Management, Service Desk/Desktop Support, IT Service Management (ITSM)

Preferred Experience:
Healthcare or hospital/ambulatory experience; Digital Leadership or IT Leadership; leading multi-site technology operations, service desk, and desktop support teams across a distributed facility footprint

Other Experience Requirements:
Proven leadership of successful transformation initiatives; deep experience managing enterprise infrastructure and disaster recovery programs, and partnering closely with cybersecurity/security leadership on secure technology operations; experience standing up or maturing an IT Service Management (ITSM) practice and associated tooling; understanding of core business and clinical processes and their associated technology solutions; strong written and verbal communication and executive presentation skills; change management; Lean or Six Sigma experience; vendor contract negotiation; and critical problem-solving and design

Knowledge/Skills

Understands the business and technical impact of emerging technologies and the issues involved in their adoption; no longer needs to be a hands-on practitioner.
Strong business acumen, customer experience, communication, and relationship-building skills.
Strategic and architectural thinker able to translate business and clinical objectives into actionable technology plans.
Strong architectural understanding of compute and compute hosting strategies, data center management, networking, service desk leadership, and desktop engineering and support.
Working knowledge of IT service management and governance frameworks (ITIL) and enterprise project management practices.
Sound understanding of cybersecurity risk and best practices; able to partner effectively with the Director, Information Security and Privacy (CISO) and other security, compliance, and risk leadership to ensure technology solutions are secure by design.
Working knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards and data exchange requirements (e.g., FHIR-based APIs, TEFCA) and their implications for enterprise architecture.
Understanding of responsible AI adoption and governance, including data quality, model oversight, and clinical safety considerations.
Strong functional understanding of the organization's core clinical and business applications and their interdependencies with the technology infrastructure and operations this role owns, most importantly the EHR, ERP, interface engine, and enterprise imaging solution.
Excellent executive presentation, written, and verbal communication skills; able to build consensus across clinical, business, and technology stakeholders.
Ability to lead and motivate distributed, cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, mission-driven healthcare environment.

new_jobs.description:
Repligen is seeking a Senior Service Systems, Infrastructure & Analytics Manager to lead the systems, data infrastructure, integrations, and analytics that support our rapidly growing global service organization. Reporting to the VP, Service, this role sits at the intersection of technology, data, and service operations, partnering across Service, IT, Commercial Operations, Finance, Quality, and Field Service to build scalable solutions that drive business performance, operational excellence, and customer success.

This role is expected to model our Leadership Behaviors—Integrity & Compliance, Customer Focus, Collaboration, Courage, Team Empowerment, and Accountability & Results—in all aspects of work.

Responsibilities

Partner with service leadership to define, document, and continuously improve global service business processes, standards, and best practices.
Translate business needs and user experiences into clear system requirements and scalable technical solutions that support the long-term growth of the service business.
Lead the design, configuration, implementation, maintenance, and optimization of service business systems and infrastructure on a global scale.
Design, manage, and enhance integrations between Salesforce, SAP, internally developed service applications, reporting platforms, and other business systems.
Develop and execute a service master data strategy, ensuring data integrity, governance, consistency, and accessibility across systems.
Build, maintain, and continuously improve dashboards, reports, and KPI frameworks that enable data-driven decision making and provide leaders with clear visibility into business performance.
Develop reporting and visualization solutions using Power BI, Tableau, and related analytics tools to deliver meaningful operational and strategic insights.
Create and manage data flows, queries, automations, and reporting structures that transform data from multiple sources into actionable business intelligence.
Act as a trusted partner to Service, IT, Commercial Operations, Finance, Quality, and Field Service teams, building strong relationships and aligning stakeholders around shared business objectives.
Provide technical guidance and business context to IT and development teams, helping prioritize enhancements, solve complex challenges, and identify opportunities for innovation.
Promote consistency and operational excellence by driving adoption of global processes, systems, and reporting methodologies across the organization.
Develop training materials, user documentation, and support programs that empower users and enable successful adoption of systems and tools.
Evaluate emerging technologies and analytics capabilities, proactively identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability, visibility, and the overall customer experience.
Take ownership of strategic initiatives from concept through implementation, driving measurable outcomes through collaboration, influence, and continuous improvement.
Help shape the future of the Service Systems, Infrastructure & Analytics function by contributing to team development, process maturity, and long-term organizational success.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related field.
7+ years of experience in business systems, analytics, systems architecture, service operations technology, or related disciplines.
Experience supporting field service, technical service, customer support, or equipment-based service organizations.
Strong experience with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, SAP, Power BI, Tableau, and related business systems.
Proven experience designing system integrations, APIs, data flows, reporting frameworks, and business process automation.
Experience developing dashboards, KPIs, and analytics solutions that support operational and strategic decision-making.
Strong understanding of data architecture, master data management, data governance, and data quality best practices.
Working knowledge of SQL, Python, Power Query, DAX, Power Automate, C#, HTML, or similar scripting and automation tools.
Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions and measurable business outcomes.
Proven success leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing stakeholders across Service, IT, Commercial Operations, Finance, and Quality organizations.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with a customer-focused mindset and a commitment to continuous improvement.

new_jobs.title: Sr. Engineering Manager, Core Services - Slack
new_jobs.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Software Engineering

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Slack is looking for an Engineering Manager on the Core Services engineering team. The purpose of this role is to keep Slack working seamlessly at massive scale — it's the infrastructure that keeps Slack feeling lightning fast. This person will be a steward of some of the most critical, high-throughput systems at Slack — the kind of work where doing it well means millions of users, at the world’s most important and interesting companies, never experience a hiccup.

About The Opportunity

We operate at tremendous scale with systems that process millions of events per second. Our team maintains and builds performant services that include:

Edge Caches
Realtime Services
Enterprise Key Management (EKM)
International Data Residency (IDR)
Image Uploads, Downloads, and Proxying

We've done our job correctly when none of our users think about us, much like a vital utility. We don't typically ship new user-facing features, but rather ensure our systems are exceptionally performant, highly available, reliable, and scalable. In other words, we make Slack work seamlessly. Slack's backend services are written in Go and Java, and Slack's API is built on PHP/Hack.

The Core Services Team

We are a team building critical services that enable Slack to scale for our largest customers. Our edge caches power the most latency-critical queries for our largest entities today, serving approximately 35% of all Slack API traffic. Our Realtime Services (RTS) power Slack's core messaging stack — running 10 services, 4 of which are mission-critical Tier 0 services — ensuring that messages, presence, and real-time events are delivered reliably at scale. We also own services that power Slack's Enterprise Key Management and International Data Residency features, enabling Slack to win and retain enterprise and government customers with strict compliance requirements (FedRAMP/NIST).

We have a strong commitment to quality and understand that simplicity and reliability are the foundations of our work.

We are actively building the future of edge services at Slack, so we can support a growing number of globally distributed customers with their compliance requirements with minimal latency.

What You'll Be Doing:

Owning the technical direction and roadmap across the Core Services portfolio: Edge Caches, Realtime Services, Enterprise Key Management, International Data Residency, and Image Proxying and Uploads. You’ll have large footprint and the opportunity to drive major impact. And you'll decide what to invest in now, what to sequence later, and what to decline — balancing reliability, migration, and new capability work.
Leading a multi-system migration of Flannel to Loom, our next-generation edge cache, while keeping the current systems running at full reliability for millions of users. You'll drive the team to ship new capabilities without introducing risk to infrastructure that people depend on daily.
Driving delivery and execution while maintaining reliability as a top priority, including sprint planning, product launches, incident follow-ups, operational sustainability analyses, and building the technical case for investment with leadership. You'll ensure the team doesn't trade reliability for velocity, but is always high-performing.
Owning on-call operations and incident management for Tier 0 services. You'll manage on-call rotations across partnering teams, triage production issues, lead incident response for your services, and drive improvements to runbooks, alerting, and operational tooling.
Partnering cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Compliance, Security, AWS, and other infrastructure teams on dependencies, timelines, and risks. You'll be the shortest path to solutions — whether it's unblocking a compliance audit for South Korea, coordinating IDR region launches with Sales and AWS, or negotiating priorities with partner teams for shared work.
Representing your team's work in leadership reviews, quarterly and annual planning, and executive forums. You'll build compelling business-and-technical cases for your team's investments and tell your leadership what's really going on early enough that nothing becomes a fire drill.
Building and maintaining a high-trust team culture where engineers do impactful work and grow. You'll hire well, manage performance with fairness and transparency, mentor emerging technical leaders, and celebrate your team's wins.
Managing cost and capacity for services that run at massive scale, working with finance on AWS spend trends, exec-approved budget increases, and cost-saving initiatives like the Loom migration (projected $1-2M savings).
Driving the team to adopt AI development tooling for maximum impact, while maintaining engineering rigor and quality for critical infrastructure.

You're Our Person If:

You've led engineering teams for 5+ years building and operating high-scale, high-availability backend infrastructure or distributed systems.
You have strong software engineering fundamentals with previous experience as a Senior+ backend engineer, with enough depth to be credible in architecture discussions about caching, distributed systems, observability and reliability best practices, and system design — and to build SME knowledge in a new area fast.
You have a history of managing Tier 0 / Tier 1 services where uptime matters deeply, including owning on-call rotations, leading incident response, and driving operational improvements.
You have experience with realtime messaging systems or event-driven architectures at scale — presence, message delivery, pub/sub, or similar systems where latency and reliability directly impact user experience.
You have experience leading multi-quarter migration or platform evolution projects while simultaneously keeping existing systems reliable.
You've managed teams through prioritization trade-offs — weighing reliability vs. feature work vs. cost vs. compliance — and can articulate those decisions to both engineers and executives.
You have experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders (Product, Sales, Compliance, Security, Infrastructure) to turn business requirements into engineering plans.
You understand how to build a high-performing team culture: hiring, performance management, retention of top performers, and growing new technical leaders.
You have experience managing engineers across multiple time zones, with an async rhythm that doesn't depend on overlap hours.
An understanding of how and where AI software development tooling can be deployed for maximum team impact.

Even Better If:

You have experience with the Go and/or Java programming language at scale.
Experience with AWS infrastructure, including multi-region architectures.
Experience with Kubernetes and container-based deployments.
Experience working within highly regulated environments where an understanding of FedRAMP/NIST frameworks was essential.
Experience with Enterprise Key Management, data residency, or compliance-driven infrastructure.
You've managed teams responsible for Edge Caching, CDN, or API gateway systems.
You've led teams through system deprecation and migration while maintaining service reliability.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form .

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. Salesforce offers a variety of benefits to help you live well including: time off programs, medical, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, 401(k), and an employee stock purchasing program. More details about company benefits can be found at the following link: https://www.salesforcebenefits.com.Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

At Salesforce, we believe in equitable compensation practices that reflect the dynamic nature of labor markets across various regions. The typical base salary range for this position is $172,500 - $260,100 annually. In select cities within the San Francisco and New York City metropolitan area, the base salary range for this role is $207,800 - $285,800 annually. The range represents base salary only, and does not include company bonus, incentive for sales roles, equity or benefits, as applicable.
